feeds.title: AFSC
feeds.description: Latest news, programs, resources and spiritual insights. Founded in 1917, the American Friends Service Committee (AFSC) is a Quaker organization that promotes lasting peace with justice, as a practical expression of faith in action.

feeds.title: LA Quaker
feeds.description: Read about upcoming events, forums and articles at LA Quaker. Anthony Manousos is a Quaker peace activist, teacher, and author, of his most recent book 'Transformative Quakers' and 'Howard and Anna Brinton: Reinventors of Quakerism in the 20th century.' He serve on the board of directors for several organizations, including the Friends World Committee for Consultation and Interfaith Communities United for Justice and Peace.

feeds.title: Friends Journal Blog
feeds.description: Read and explore articles, essays, book reviews, and videos to learn more about Quaker experience. Friends Journal's mission is to communicate Quaker experience in order to connect and deepen spiritual lives.

feeds.title: School of the Spirit Ministry
feeds.description: Read our call & core characteristics of Upcoming Events. School of the Spirit Ministry serves all those who wish to be more faithful listeners and responders to the work of the Inward Teacher. The ministry is grounded in prayer and offers programs rooted in the Quaker contemplative tradition of the living Silence.

feeds.title: Northern Friends Peace Board
feeds.description: Latest new, updates and annual reports. Northern Friends Peace Board (NFPB) is a Quaker group that supports and encourages 'the active promotion of peace in all its height and breadth'.

feeds.title: Quakers in Ireland
feeds.description: Quakers have a great diversity of beliefs, and while words can divide them, the shared experience of silent worship, seeking to practice Christ's message of love and compassion unites them. They know theirs is not the only path to God, but believe it is the right one for them. They are formally known as the Religious Society of Friends. Dive into their blog and learn more about the latest news, resources, events, and more.

feeds.title: OLD CHATHAM QUAKERS
feeds.description: This blog was set up to post content of interest to Old Chatham Quaker members and attenders. Posts related to one's own personal spiritual journey, reports based on interviews with others, and reflections on Quaker-related topics.

feeds.title: Through the Flaming Sword
feeds.description: Exploring Quaker spirituality, history, faith & practice. Through the Flaming Sword, is venue for conversation about the history and future of the Religious Society of Friends, popularly known as Quakers.

feeds.title: Quaker Ranter
feeds.description: Read about curated and contextualized newsletter of Quaker discussions by Martin Kelley at Quaker Ranter.

feeds.title: New Foundation Fellowship
feeds.description: Posts on Friends of Society and Yearly Meeting. At New Foundation Fellowship we believe that a real need exists today for the insights of George Fox into the true meaning of the Gospel. We have been brought into a fellowship as we work together to proclaim that 'God and Christ has come to teach his people himself''.

feeds.title: Jolly Quaker
feeds.description: Post on useful theology from a Quaker-shaped Christian.

feeds.title: The QCEA Blog
feeds.description: Covers thoughts and comments from staff and volunteers at the Quaker Council for European Affairs. The Quaker Council for European Affairs brings a vision based on the Quaker commitment to peace, justice, and equality to Europe and its institutions.

feeds.title: Quaker House Blog
feeds.description: Read news, events and resources at Quaker House. Quaker House is a manifestation of the Friends' Peace Testimony that provides counseling and support to service members who are questioning their role in the military and advocates for a more peaceful world.

feeds.title: Quaker Strongrooms
feeds.description: Get up to date news about the Library, including new accessions, service developments, and details of forthcoming events. Quaker Strongrooms introduce you to their unique collections and preservation about the library.

feeds.title: Musings of a Quaker Witch
feeds.description: Covers ministry and Priestessing in its many facets, Quakerism, Paganism, social justice, healing, music, and all sorts of things. Musings of a Quaker Witch is a Quaker in the unprogrammed tradition; Witch in the feminist and eclectic tradition of Roses.

feeds.title: What Canst Thou Say?
feeds.description: Read stories on christian conversion by Robin Mohr. Robin is a relatively low-tech, Green, feminist, convergent Quaker, with lots of references to children and the occasional pie recipe.

feeds.title: Stumbling blocks to stepping stones
feeds.description: Articles on spiritual autobiography project by Fil Skidmore. Gil have been engaged in for over 40 years and exploring where Quakers and his Inward Teacher have taken and are taking him.

feeds.title: Woodbrooke
feeds.description: Read news and articles on learning, connection, and worship at Woodbrooke. Woodbrooke is an international Quaker learning and research organisation based in Britain, with a mission to foster the 'vital ministry' of Quakers today.

feeds.title: The Postmodern Quaker
feeds.description: Read articles on Quakers belief, history, faith and spirituality by George Amoss Jr. George is a participant in worship and other activities, including Experiment with Light, at Homewood Friends Meeting in Baltimore, MD, USA, where he has served as presiding clerk, and occasionally at Little Falls Meeting in Fallston, Maryland.

feeds.title: Holy Ordinary: The Sacraments of Everyday Life
feeds.description: A blog on compendium of writing, photography, seriousness, and silliness. Brent Bill is a minister, photographer, retreat leader, author, and Quaker. He is the author of 'Awaken Your Senses,' 'Holy Silence: The Gift of Quaker Spirituality,' 'Mind the Light: Learning to See with Spiritual Eyes' and 'Sacred Compass: The Path of Spiritual Discernment' (foreword by Richard Foster).

feeds.title: Transition Quaker
feeds.description: Read articles on Friends of Society, Quakers belief and history by Transition Quaker. Craig is a Quaker living in Sheffield (UK), and currently serving on Britain Yearly Meeting's Book of Discipline Revision Committee. He works for a local refugee charity and is a co-chair of the Sheffield City of Sanctuary.

feeds.title: QuakerQuaker
feeds.description: Get daily guide to the best of the Quaker conversation, community blogs, media, and resources for newcomers. A community of friends & seekers exploring the Quaker way in today's world.

feeds.title: Friends General Conference
feeds.description: Articles on latest events, workshop and gatherings. FGC is an association of local and regional Quaker organizations primarily in the United States and Canada. Together they nurture the spiritual vitality of Friends.

feeds.title: Quakers In Canada
feeds.description: Read news, events and publication at Quakers Canada. The electronic meeting place for Canadian Quakers in the unprogrammed tradition, united since 1955 as Canadian Yearly Meeting of the Religious Society of Friends.
